elements.name: I left the house
elements.text:
I left the house
while the town was still quiet

elements.name: The shutters roll up one by one
elements.text:
The shutters roll up one by one
and the town starts moving

elements.name: The bell goes ding-ding
elements.text:
The bell goes ding-ding
and the train slides past

elements.name: Up the hill
elements.text:
Up the hill
the school roof comes into view

elements.name: Beyond the window
elements.text:
Beyond the window
the same old town spreads out
